_comment: Profile for type-checking tests (no emit). Loosens module-syntax strictness so test fixtures type-check. `allowJs` overrides base.json solely so a test program can import the shared `@codexo/exojs-config` presets, which are plain ESM annotated with JSDoc because the tools that load them do so at runtime; they are type-checked in tsconfig.scripts.json, which owns them. No test tree contains JavaScript of its own. Package-local config sets include + test type packages + customConditions.
